subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing unmentioned speech changes privacy, security, cost, and configuration semantics beyond a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before wiring it into the Discord preflight/history path.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel media history
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input until maintainers define one media-retention policy that applies across Discord, WhatsApp, Signal, and similar channels.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained before an explicit invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before wiring it into the Discord preflight/history path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal across Discord preflight, config, and pending-history ownership plus the related audio detection merge.
